record.title: Spectroscopy topics
record.name: SpectroscopyTopics
record.content:
A toopic on spectroscopy topics
\begin{itemize} \item Electrical fields \item Magnetic fields \item Electromagnetic fields and waves \item Maxwell's equations \item Vector calculus in electrostatics \item Vector and scalar potentials \item Kramers-Kronig relations \item Stokes theorem \item Laplace equation \item Poisson equation \item Polarization \item Polarizability \item Poynting vector \item Reflection spectroscopy (NIR, vis, electron, etc.) \item Transmission spectroscopy (vis/UV, NIR/IR, etc.) \item Absorption spectroscopy (vis/UV, NIR/IR, NMR, EPR/ESR, FMR etc.) \item Spectroscopy and spectrophotometry \item Coherent spectroscopy of atoms and molecules \item Electron spectroscopy (x-ray photoelectron (XPS), Auger electron spectroscopy (AES), and so on) \item EXAFS and X-ray spectroscopy \item Neutron spectroscopy \item Mössbauer spectroscopy \item Infrared and Raman spectroscopy \item Hyperspectral (NIR, IR, UV/vis) imaging \item Fresnel equations \item Diffraction equations \item Electric dipoles \item Dipole-dipole interactions \item dipole-induced dipole interactions \item Ion-dipole interactions \item London dispersion forces, \item Total intermolecular pair potentials \item Optical constants \item Extinction coefficient \item Refraction and reflection coefficients \item Total internal reflection \item Derivation of the Kramers-Kronig relations \item Lorentz model \item AC and DC conductivity \item Displacement \item Skin depth \end{itemize}
